sanskrit: yo 'smān ūrdhvāyā diśo 'ghāyur abhidāsāt | etat sa ṛcchād aśmavarma no 'stu ||
english: Whoever, bearing evil intent, should assail us from the upward direction — may he meet that; let the armour of stone be ours.

sanskrit: prācyai diśe svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to the eastern direction.

sanskrit: dakṣiṇāyai diśe svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to the southern direction.

sanskrit: pratīcyai diśe svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to the western direction.

sanskrit: udīcyai diśe svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to the northern direction.

sanskrit: dhruvāyai diśe svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to the fixed (nadir) direction.

sanskrit: ūrdhvāyai diśe svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to the upward direction.

sanskrit: dive svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to heaven.

sanskrit: antarikṣāya svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to the atmosphere.

sanskrit: pṛthivyai svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to the earth.

sanskrit: pṛthivyai svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to the earth.

sanskrit: antarikṣāya svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to the atmosphere.

sanskrit: dive svāhā ||
english: Svāhā to heaven.

sanskrit: mahākaṇṭhaṃ karīṣajam ūbadhyādam anāhutim | oṣṭhaḥ kokamukhaś ca yas tān ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: The great-throated one, born of dung, the belly-devourer, the unworshipped one; Oṣṭha, Kokamukha — these and whoever else they are, from here we drive them away.

sanskrit: rāmadantam avadalaṃ prahālam ahināsikam | upavartaṃ balāhakaṃ khelaṃ gardabhanādinaṃ gṛdhraṃ hastyāyanaṃ tān (…) ||
english: Rāmadanta, Avadala, Prahāla, Ahināsika; Upavarta, Balāhaka, Khela, Gardabhanādina, the vulture-one, Hastyāyana — these [from here we drive away].

sanskrit: pramṛśyādinam abhyamaṃ bhīmahastaṃ marīmṛśam | trastākṣaṃ mṛdvaṅguliṃ nakhograṃ dantavīryaṃ tān (…) ||
english: Pramṛśyādina, Abhyama, Bhīmahasta, Marīmṛśa; Trastākṣa, Mṛdvaṅguli, Nakhogra, Dantavīrya — these [from here we drive away].

sanskrit: paryanyam abhipāpadaṃ jigīṣamāṇaṃ rūpakam | atho śalalyaṃ śevalaṃ tān (…) ||
english: Paryanya, Abhipāpada, the form-taking one who ever seeks to conquer; and also Śalalya, Śevala — these [from here we drive away].

sanskrit: taṇḍam agretuṇḍikam aliṃśam uta vatsapam | dāmagranthiṃ sanisrasam araṇyeyaṃ cārmyeyaṃ tān (…) ||
english: Taṇḍa, Agretuṇḍika, Aliṃśa, and also Vatsapa; Dāmagranthi, Sanisrasa, the forest-dweller, the skin-dweller — these [from here we drive away].

sanskrit: idaṃ yaj jānukeśavaṃ rakṣaś caraty āsuraṃ bahiḥ prayutam icchati | aṃsūn pāṃsyūṃś ca keśyān arāyāñ chvakiṣkiṇas tān ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: This Jānukeśava, this demon that roams about — the āsura who seeks what has been sent forth — along with Aṃsū, Pāṃsyu, the hairy ones (Keśyāḥ), the stealers (Arāyāḥ), the dog-squeakers (Śvakiṣkiṇaḥ) — these from here we drive away.

sanskrit: yaḥ kumārāñ janasyātti taruṇān dāsa āsuraḥ | arāyaḥ keśy aghalo yo janān hanty atti ca tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: The dāsa, the āsura, who devours the young children of people; Arāya, Keśin, Aghala — the one who strikes down and devours human beings — him from here we drive away.

sanskrit: hirākṣo nāma gehyo 'rāyo nāma sūrtahā | tam ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: The house-haunter named Hirākṣa, the slayer of the well-formed named Arāya — him from here we drive away.

sanskrit: vitūlaṃ bhasvam ākhidaṃ vanakrośaṃ ca roruham | āmādaṃ prayutaiṣaṇaṃ paryundānaṃ paridravaṃ vṛkasya nyañcaṃ gaṅgaṇaṃ tān ito nāśayāmasi ||
english: Vitūla, Bhasva, Ākhida, Vanakrośa, Roruha; Āmāda, Prayutaiṣaṇa, Paryundāna, Paridrava, the downward-pulling one of the wolf, Gaṅgaṇa — these from here we drive away.

sanskrit: yaś ca bhūmā yā ca sphātir yorjā yo rasaś ca te | harāmi śakra tām̐ ahaṃ tvayā prattāṃ śacīpate ||
english: Whatever abundance is yours, whatever increase, whatever vital vigor, whatever essence — those, O Śakra, I take away; they are granted by you, O lord of Śacī.

sanskrit: kṣetrātkṣetrād ā harāmi sphātiṃ sarvāṃ śacīpate | tvayāhaṃ vṛtrahan prattam ā harāmi gṛhām̐ upa ||
english: From field to field I take away all increase, O lord of Śacī; what has been granted by you, O Vṛtrahan, I bring hither to my house.

sanskrit: yas te sītābhagaḥ kṣetre yā rāddhir yac ca śīyate | atho yā niṣṭhā te kṣetre tāṃ ta ādiṣi brahmaṇā ||
english: The portion of the furrow that is in your field, the prosperity and what is scattered there; moreover, the residue that remains in your field — that I have pointed out to myself by the sacred word.

sanskrit: yat khale yan mayāre yad goṣṭhe yac ca śevadhau | atho yat kumbhyāṃ śaye tasya te rasam ā dade ||
english: What is on the threshing floor, what is in the granary, what is in the cattle pen, and what is in the treasure hoard; moreover, what lies in the storage jar — of that I take the essence from you.

sanskrit: ūrjā yā te niruptasya- -ūrjā yāvahatasya te | ūrjāṃ te piṣyamāṇasya- -ūrjāṃ piṣṭāt ta ā dade ||
english: The vigor of what has been winnowed out for you, the vigor of what has been threshed for you; the vigor of what is being ground for you — the vigor from your ground grain I take.

sanskrit: (…) te niruptasya- -ūrjā yāvahatasya te | ūrjāṃ te pacyamānasya- -ūrjāṃ pakvāt te (…) ||
english: [The vigor] of what has been winnowed out for you, the vigor of what has been threshed for you; the vigor of what is being cooked for you — the vigor from your cooked [food I take].

sanskrit: ūrjā yā te praṇaddhasya- -ūrjā yā mathitasya te | ūrjāṃ te duhyamānasya- -ūrjāṃ dugdhāt ta ā dade ||
english: The vigor of what has been bound up for you, the vigor of what has been churned for you; the vigor of what is being milked for you — the vigor from your milk I take.

sanskrit: ā te dade gavām ūrjām ūrjām avibhya ā dade | ajābhya ūrjām ādāya- -ā ta ekaśaphād dade ||
english: I take from you the vigor of your cows; from your sheep I take the vigor; taking the vigor from your goats — from your single-hoofed animals I take it for myself.

sanskrit: ūrjā yā te puruṣeṣu- -ūrjā vitte ca vedye | ūrjāṃ te sarveṣām ahaṃ gṛhāṇāṃ brahmaṇā dade ||
english: The vigor that is in your people, the vigor in your acquired and known wealth; the vigor of all your households — that I bestow upon myself by the sacred word.
